sourceReview.reason: Rechecked LI.FI's November 17 announcement as reproduced from its social post, November 18 Blockchain.News coverage, and LI.FI's earlier September product update. The new claim is social-post-based and the news item repeats it; no accessible full-text dated primary release or two independent full-text reports verify a distinct launch with three new facts. Existing Base tokenized-equity integrations predate the headline. Remains held; retry no sooner than six hours after this review.
